ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity dominant; approximately 85% dark/black pixels to 15% high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling concentrated at the terminal 20% of both lateral lobes; right distal lobe contains a distinctive dark circular pixel void (~15 pixels diameter) surrounded by white field; left distal lobe features a dense cluster of overlapping linear white marks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 105 degrees and a relative depth of 12% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration; inner regions near notch show low-amplitude (~3-5 pixels) rhythmic peaks; distal regions show larger, jagged, non-uniform peaks (~10-15 pixels) and deeper indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal trajectory; concave curvature at the medial trailing edge transitioning to convex toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density 3D clusters of high-intensity pixels (barnacles) at both extreme lateral tips; multiple circular white-bordered scars (cookie-cutter type) visible on the left-central lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional, high-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) scattered across the mid-ventral regions, more prominent on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy epibiotic colonization (barnacles) on the terminal edges of both lobes; numerous circular attachment scars and rake marks visible across the pigmented surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, highly localized dark 'eye' spot situated within the white pigmentation patch of the right distal fluke tip.
